name: Ashaya
description: Ashaya, the Awoken World, is a giant tree-like elemental, a manifestation of Zendikar's soul, who is Nissa's companion and closest friend.

description_citations.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.
"Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

summary.text: Ashaya, the Awoken World, is a giant tree-like elemental, a manifestation of Zendikar's soul, who is Nissa's companion and closest friend.

citations.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.
"Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

bio.text: Nissa named the elemental Ashaya after Hamadi's name for her, and by mimicking its gesture she saw the leylines stream from her fingers and understood she was one with Zendikar.

citations.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.
"For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.
"For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

bio.text: Nissa and Ashaya fought Eldrazi together, rescuing humans at Fartree Hamlet and killing the creatures there.

citations.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.
"The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.
"The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

bio.text: When Ob Nixilis tore Zendikar's connection away, Ashaya collapsed and shattered, and Nissa later escaped with the Khalni Heart and the revived Ashaya.

citations.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.
"Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

bio.text: Ashaya helped dig up hedrons for the ring around Ulamog, but when Nissa called on it again it cracked and crumbled as the prison failed.

citations.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.
"Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

bio.text: In Zendikar Rising Ashaya merged with Nissa in full power, pinned Jace, and took the Core from him and gave it to Nissa.

"Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

status.text: As of the latest story featuring it, Ashaya is alive and fighting beside Nissa in the Singing City, with the Core's power channeled through Nissa and Ashaya.

citations.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: An elemental that does not return to the land becomes Nissa's companion, Ashaya.
timeline.quote: It became her companion

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Worldwaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya watch from a ridge over the Vastwood Forest, looking at the white corruption left by Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi drained the life and essence from all the living things they encountered.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa names the elemental Ashaya, the Awoken World, after Hamadi's name for her.
timeline.quote: "Okay then, Ashaya it is," Nissa said.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa questions why Zendikar chose her again after she failed the first time, and Ashaya repeats its confusing gesture.
timeline.quote: I failed. Last time you chose me, I failed.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya hear screams and see Eldrazi attacking a small encampment.
timeline.quote: "There!" Nissa pointed.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya crush the first Eldrazi, fight the tentacled one and cripple it, but the third carries off the kor, who is consumed.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi consumed the kor's life, turning her still, pale body into dust.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa takes the seeds as the vampire argues no effort can beat the titans; Ashaya watches, and the vampire vanishes.
timeline.quote: She took the seeds.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Mimicking Ashaya's gesture, Nissa sees glowing leylines stream from her fingers and understands Zendikar did not choose her but she is one with it.
timeline.quote: These were the leylines

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she was never chosen or alone but one with Zendikar and cries 'For Zendikar!', charging into the forest bonded to the land.
timeline.quote: "For Zendikar!" she cried

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the one-tentacled Eldrazi with a spear of land and a punch from Ashaya.
timeline.quote: The horror let out a final deflating chitter as it collapsed.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa rides Ashaya and calls an army of baloth-sized elementals as they hunt an Eldrazi titan.
timeline.quote: an army of baloth-sized elementals took shape.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Ashaya relays a distress call from Fartree Hamlet, and Nissa and Ashaya rush to help, finding three Eldrazi instead of two.
timeline.quote: But the chatter was wrong; there were three Eldrazi, not two.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa chooses to attack the twin Eldrazi at the hamlet first, planning to reach the heart trees after.
timeline.quote: "We have to give the most help we can give,"

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya rescue the humans from the treehouses by bending a tree and shielding them with a wall of land.
timeline.quote: Nissa pulled on the tree, urging it to bend to her.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the first twin Eldrazi by snapping the tree into its faceplate and gutting it.
timeline.quote: Its limbs went limp, and then the monstrous thing teetered back and crashed to the forest floor.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa rips the second twin apart with root tentacles and saves the humans from its falling body.
timeline.quote: carried the people back and away as the Eldrazi struck the ground.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya arrive too late at the thicket, where the Eldrazi has killed all but two heart trees, and then kill it.
timeline.quote: The monster was both killed and buried in the same stroke.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya promise the last heart tree that Zendikar will fight on, and they press on in pursuit of the titan.
timeline.quote: Zendikar would fight back.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya are struck by terrible pain as the connection to Zendikar is torn away, and Ashaya collapses and shatters.
timeline.quote: Nissa watched as Ashaya's branches snapped and shattered on the ground.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes in silence, unable to feel Zendikar or Ashaya, and stumbles toward a sea of Eldrazi at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: But there was nothing there to grasp.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa beats Ob Nixilis at the Khalni Heart and escapes with it and the revived Ashaya.
timeline.quote: Flush with the elemental power of Zendikar, Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped with the revived Ashaya.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa drives a fist of land into the demon and rises with Ashaya, who returns as her friend.
timeline.quote: Nissa rose up, and so too did the world's soul, her friend.

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya set off to return to Sea Gate and join Gideon's battle cry.
timeline.quote: Nissa and Ashaya would return to Sea Gate, they would meet Gideon's army

citation.text: "Nissa's Resolve" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Through the night Nissa and Ashaya dig up hedrons and the kor and Zendikari teams hoist them into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: They pulled and tightened their ropes in opposite directions, slowing the hedron to a gentle stop.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa calls on Ashaya, but Ashaya cracks and crumbles and the world shakes.
timeline.quote: Then something broke.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: On a skiff across the river, Nissa thinks of Ashaya and of her place in the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She thought of Ashaya then, her elemental companion, a fragment of the world-soul of Zendikar

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Cut off from the earth, Nissa recalls her only other equal isolation, when Ob Nixilis tore Ashaya from her (flashback).
timeline.quote: when the demon Ob Nixilis had disrupted the ley lines on Zendikar and torn Ashaya from her

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Jace find the focal point destroyed, and Nissa arrives with Ashaya, claiming the elementals destroyed it.
timeline.quote: It was," Nissa replied, coldly, "until the elementals destroyed it.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya merge in full power and attack Nahiri, who flees with Jace through the city.
timeline.quote: The Soul of the Wild seemed to swell with strength, with the drive to protect.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa and her elementals have destroyed the focal point and attack Jace and Nahiri; Jace takes control of Nahiri's mind and the Core, but Ashaya takes it and hands it to Nissa.
timeline.quote: he was caught by Ashaya who took the Core and handed it to Nissa herself.

citation.text: "Lithoform Core", section "The Singing City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa destroys Nahiri's focal point in the Singing City with Ashaya and her elementals.
timeline.quote: Nissa had destroyed it with Ashaya and her other elementals

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace escapes the city with the Core, but Ashaya pins him and tosses the Core to Nissa.
timeline.quote: And into Nissa's waiting hands.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes Jace is trying to take control of her mind, snaps the link and has Ashaya hold him down.
timeline.quote: Jace was trying to take control of her mind.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya confront Nahiri and Jace; Nissa destroys the leyline focal point, halting Nahiri's plan to activate the Core.
timeline.quote: A battle ensued that culminated in Nissa destroying the leyline focal point

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace infiltrates the city, traps Nahiri's mind with a psychic illusion and seizes the Core, but Ashaya takes it and gives it to Nissa.
timeline.quote: he trapped her mind with a psychic illusion and seized the Core

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace tries to seize control of Nissa's mind and Ashaya restrains him; Nissa merges the Core's power with her own as Nahiri attacks.
timeline.quote: Nissa tapped into the Core's power and merged it with her own, unleashing a powerful burst of energy.

citation.text: "Singing City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Akiri travel to the Singing City to mediate; Jace is overcome by the resonance but escapes and finds Nissa and Ashaya.
timeline.quote: Jace was temporarily overcome by the ruins' song-mad cacophony

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa destroys the leyline focal point Nahiri intended to use; conflict escalates and Jace seizes the Core with illusions before Ashaya returns it to Nissa.
timeline.quote: Ashaya intervened and returned the Core to Nissa.

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Core reveals it was born from Zendikar, and Nissa merges it with her elemental connection, channeling its power through herself and Ashaya.
timeline.quote: Nissa allowed the Core to merge with her elemental connection

citation.text: "Healing of Zendikar", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Ashaya!" Nissa ran for her friend

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

relations.quote: her elemental companion, a fragment of the world-soul of Zendikar

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

relations.note: Nissa is united with Ashaya, a living embodiment of Zendikar.
relations.quote: I help them, and they help me.

citation.work: Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings
citation.text: "Episode 4: Of Haunting Songs and Whispered Warnings" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2020.

relations.note: Ashaya follows her commands, restraining Jace.
relations.quote: silently asked Ashaya to make sure Jace couldn't move

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.
